title: A reproducible social-post draft workflow
summary: This source describes an open-source workflow that prepares platform-specific social post drafts with explicit human approval before real publication.

claims.text: ReachWeaver creates drafts for different social media platforms.
claims.limitation: Publication support differs by platform and account; verify current support.

creator_questions: Can an independent creator reproduce the demo using their own files?
Which steps still require manual review or a platform-native app?
